title: Grounding practices for home
intro: Protection begins with creating a home rhythm that helps you feel present and steady.

sections.heading: Reset the room
sections.body: Open a window, clear a surface, and let the space change.

sections.heading: Choose a cue
sections.body: Use a light, sound, prayer, or breath as a return point.

sections.heading: Keep support close
sections.body: If fear or distress grows, involve trusted or professional support.
